title: Mustards, mustard oils and mycorrhizas
abstract: Intact, living routs of Brassica Kaber (DC.) Wheeler and Brassica nigra. L. Roots from two similarly non‐mycotrophic species, spinach (Chenopodiaceae) and Amaranthus retroflexus L. (Amaranthaceae). had no effect on the germination of spores of G. intraradices.
